name: flats
description: Deploy agent-built websites to your own Flats host: versions, previews, rollback, private (Tailscale) or public (Portal) flats.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy sites to your Flats host
interface.longDescription: Save a Private Draft and preview it, request approval to create a numbered version, then request separate approval to deploy it. Versions stay until explicitly deleted.
